text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and NCCL stall signatures detected for `kv-tp-pool`. Metric cluster: kv_cache_evictions + NCCL_allgather_timeouts rising simultaneously. Severity: potential P1. Paging on-call (sam).

sam: on-call, acknowledging. pulling dashboards now (kv cache, nccl, continuous-batching queue). Any immediate customer-facing impacts?

luca: Support: ~9 tenants showing elevated failures; primary reports from beta-cust and marketplace-io. Failures are intermittent 502/503 on `/v1/chat/completions`. Support tickets created and flagged for P1 notices.

mira: eng-runtime here. Quick read: continuous-batching backlog for TP pools spiked; one TP rank (rank 1 in a 8-way TP) has disproportionately large KV store (20GB) compared to others (~1.2GB). NCCL AllGather operations show 90s tail timeouts. Suspect shard mapping regression after yesterday's rollout of the shard selector optimizer. Might be modulo-bias for short key fingerprints.

devin: logs from pod kv-runtime-1-7f8:
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] WARN kv_cache: local_cache_mb=20480 remote_cache_mb=128 eviction_pressure=0.92
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] ERROR nccl: allgather failed - timeout waiting for peers
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] ERROR runtime: failed to append KV chunk - OOM
```

jana (eng-sre): Are there autoscale events? Could be a scheduling imbalance + shader. Checking node GPU memory outliers.

mira: immediate mitigation plan: 1) flip runtime flags to cap per-shard cache and disable cross-GPU KV sharing 2) temporarily disable continuous batching for `kv-tp-pool` to stop compounding backlog 3) cordon & drain offending node to redistribute hot pod 4) prepare a non-breaking hotfix to shard selection (move to 64-bit xxhash + fold).

sam: can we do 1-2 via config change (no image deploy)? If yes, do it now and tell customers.

mira: yes. updating ConfigMap `kv-runtime-config` with flags:
```
kv_cache:
  max_shard_mb: 4096
  cross_gpu_kv: false
  continuous_batching: false
```
Applying patch and restart subset of TP pods (rolling 2 at a time).

ops-bot: Runbook `kv-tp-cache-eviction` launched by sam. Estimated time to mitigation: 22m.

luca: drafting customer interim: "We've detected a skew in shard distribution causing elevated errors for a subset of customers. Engineering has applied config mitigations and is restarting affected workers. We'll update in 30 minutes."

(3m)

mira: ConfigMap patched, issuing `kubectl rollout restart deploy/kv-runtime -n prod --selector=pool=kv-tp-pool` but gating to avoid mass churn.

ops-bot: rollout progress: 1/6 updated, 5/6 unchanged. One restarted pod entered CrashLoopBackOff on node gpu-18.

devin: Crashloops due to huge local cache persisted on disk; scheduler re-scheduling hit node with local data. Recommended: cordon gpu-18 and drain. Commands:
```
kubectl cordon node/gpu-18
kubectl drain node/gpu-18 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

jana: performing cordon/drain now. Expect pod to be recreated on gpu-23.

(5m)

jana: drain complete, pod recreated on gpu-23 and came up healthy. Observability: per-shard sizes evening out. NCCL timeouts falling to 0 on tail samples.

mira: while config mitigations look good, we still need a code hotfix for the shard selector. Proposed change: replace naive `hash(key) % N` with fold-xor of xxhash64 then multiply-shift to reduce bias. Patch snippet:
```
- shard = hash64(key) % num_shards
+ h = xxhash64(key)
+ shard = ((h ^ (h >> 33)) * 0xff51afd7ed558ccd) >> (64 - log2ceil(num_shards))
```

devin: adding e2e and statistical unit tests to validate distribution under small keyspace and skewed prefixes. Will deploy hotfix to canary pool first. PR #4921 opened.

luca: customer update sent: "Mitigations applied; errors trending down. We're rolling a targeted fix and will follow up with RCA."

(20m)

mira: canary deploy with hotfix image `kv-runtime:shard-fix-20260315` started against `kv-tp-canary` pool. Health checks passing. Monitoring: shard distribution test histogram looks uniform. No nccl regressions.

sam: once canary stable, plan full rollout with 3m pause windows and extra watchers on NCCL metrics. Also add alert to trigger earlier when per-shard size ratio > 3x.

jana: added alert rule `kv.shard.skew_ratio > 3` to pager with SLO thresholds.

(27m)

mira: full rollout underway. Pauses at each pool to validate metrics. Continuous batching will remain disabled for 10m after each pool to ensure no backlog bounce.

(35m)

mira: rollout complete. KV shard sizes normalized, eviction pressure back to baseline (0.05), NCCL allgather tail cleared. 5xx rates for affected routes down to background.

devin: merged PR tests. Also added regression test to the perf harness that simulates tiny keyspaces and verifies no shard hot-spotting. PR #4921 merged and scheduled for stable branch.

luca: final customer summary: 9 tenants affected, peak elevated errors ~+12% for a 28-minute window; impacted requests ~15k; most returned transient 502/503; no user data corrupted. Sent closing messages to customers and closed incident tickets.

ops-bot: Incident resolved. Duration: 00:36:04.

sam: I'll open the postmortem doc and assign action items: shard algorithm audit (devin), alert tuning (jana), durable eviction guardrails (mira). Thanks all.

mira: handing back to sam for customer comms and postmortem writeup.

sam: thanks team. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
